what: Static Checks for Common CRAN Submission Mistakes
title: Static Checks for Common CRAN Submission Mistakes
text: goal cranlint catch common, easy--miss mistakes made preparing R package CRAN submission – things like hardcoded random seeds, DESCRIPTION formatting issues, writes .GlobalEnv – complement (rather duplicate) tools like urlchecker, lintr, spelling. Many checks used package heuristics: treat output definitive diagnostic. exists help detect common problems, serve authoritative source.

title: Static Checks for Common CRAN Submission Mistakes
text: lint_cran() runs every cranlint check package returns single tibble findings. ’s pointed tiny example package two easy--miss issues: one-sentence Description field, hardcoded set.seed() call inside function.
code: library(cranlint)  pkg_dir <- tempfile("examplepkg") dir.create(file.path(pkg_dir, "R"), recursive = TRUE)  writeLines(   c(     "Package: examplepkg",     "Title: An Example Package",     "Version: 0.0.1",     "Authors@R: person(\"Jane\", \"Doe\", email = \"jane@example.com\", role = c(\"aut\", \"cre\"))",     "Description: Does a thing.",     "License: MIT + file LICENSE"   ),   file.path(pkg_dir, "DESCRIPTION") )  writeLines(   c(     "simulate <- function() {",     "  set.seed(42)",     "  rnorm(1)",     "}"   ),   file.path(pkg_dir, "R", "simulate.R") )  lint_cran(pkg_dir) #> # A tibble: 2 × 6 #>   check              file          line severity   message      policy_reference #>   <chr>              <chr>        <int> <ord>      <chr>        <chr>            #> 1 description_length DESCRIPTION     NA should_fix The Descrip… https://contrib… #> 2 hardcoded_seed     R/simulate.R     2 should_fix set.seed() … https://contrib…

text: Flags every line containing \dontrun{ package's man/*.Rd files. soft, review-level finding rather hard fail: \dontrun{} legitimate way mark example code genuinely run checking (e.g. needs credentials, network resource, illustrative pseudo-code), also easy reach habit code run fine, run via \donttest{} instead (CRAN run, just every regular check) – code inside \dontrun{} never executed R CMD check, can silently rot. Static analysis tell case applies, every occurrence surfaced human judge.
